entity.name: Lucide Icons
entity.description: Lucide Icons is the team that maintains Lucide, a community-driven, open-source icon library. The project is led by Eric Fennis together with co-maintainer Karsa Mistmere.

projects.name: Lucide
projects.description: Beautiful and consistent icon toolkit made by the community. Lucide provides a large set of open-source SVG icons plus official packages for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Preact, Angular, React Native and vanilla JavaScript, along with a Figma plugin. It is free for personal and commercial use under the ISC license.

plans.name: Maintainer time
plans.description: Funds 44 hours of maintenance per week: 32 hours for Eric Fennis and 12 hours for Karsa Mistmere at EUR 40 per hour. Covers reviewing icon contributions, maintaining the framework packages, releases, documentation and community support.

plans.name: Infrastructure and tooling
plans.description: Covers hosting on DigitalOcean (EUR 1,200/year), the domain (EUR 10/year), design and project tools Figma, Notion and Linear (EUR 900/year) and AI coding assistance (EUR 240/year).

plans.name: Custom contribution
plans.description: Contribute any amount to support Lucide.
